The Software R&D Engineer – Scanner is responsible for developing and maintaining software for lithography scanner tools used in semiconductor manufacturing. This includes optimizing HMI, PC platforms, and device control systems. The role also involves leading continuous improvement projects and migrating software to next-generation platforms to align with business and sustainability goals.
A strong background in PLC ladder logic and proficiency in C# programming are essential for troubleshooting, maintaining, and enhancing scanner software. This position offers the opportunity to solve complex challenges and contribute to the advancement of semiconductor technology.
Task:
• Collaborate with the engineering team to develop new features, diagnose root causes, and provide technical support to both the product line and field service teams.
• Further standardization of the components used between different module platforms.
• Process improvements and quality mindset in design perspective in order to secure production output and deal with customer issue escalation.
• Having risk assessments (FMEA) in issue investigation and test planning capability
• Software package/patch version control and provide release notes to stakeholders
• Involved in ECR (Engineering Change Requests) and CIP (Continued Improvement Projects) according to internal/external customer’s requests.
• Responsible for solution delivery and commitment on project timelines.
Characteristic:
• Teamwork: Able to work in a cross function and international environment.
• Self-learning: Able to collect information to improve your knowledge pool, and also help the growth of the team by sharing knowledge.
• Proactive: Willing to tackle with technical challenges and the mindset of seeking solutions for continuous improvement.
• Planning: Result oriented thoughts for assigned task and project.
Business travel requirement:
• Less than 2 month a year.
• Maximum 10% support at customer side
